topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture's scope and learning goals before the substantive discussion begins.

topics.label: Mutation-driven clonal evolution and epigenetic tumor development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how changes within cells drive tumor development, extending mutation-based explanations to changes in transcriptional state.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stemness and a cell's position in a tissue hierarchy affect its capacity to initiate or propagate cancer.

topics.label: Inflammation-induced stemness as a promoter of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics show how inflammatory signals can enable mutant cells to form tumors by inducing a stem-like state.

topics.label: Stromal support and therapeutic targeting of established tumors
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines established tumors' dependence on their surrounding stroma as a potential therapeutic vulnerability.

topics.label: Investigating and integrating the determinants of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer evolution can be understood by examining molecular changes and cell states in their environmental context.

topics.label: Lecture close and next lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic ends the lecture and announces the next session on therapy.
